subject: food-technology
title: Energy Balance
welcome_lead: Energy in vs energy out — and the science behind weight management.
meta_desc: A-Level Food Tech: energy balance, BMR, TEE.
final_note: Energy in equals energy out — over time.

concepts.def: Equality of energy intake and energy expenditure.
Basal Metabolic Rate — energy used at rest to sustain life.
Total Energy Expenditure — BMR + activity + thermic effect.
Physical Activity Level — TEE expressed as a multiple of BMR.
Energy cost of digesting/absorbing food (~10% of intake).

walkthroughs.body_html: Energy balance = energy in − energy out. Sustained positive balance stores energy as fat; sustained negative balance depletes stores. Over time, balance determines weight.
BMR covers basic body functions (heart, brain, liver) — about 60-75% of TEE for sedentary adults. TEE = BMR × PAL. Sedentary PAL ~1.4; very active ~2.0+.
Henry equation (UK, 2005): for 18-30 y male, BMR (MJ/d) = 0.063 × weight + 2.896. Mifflin-St Jeor (1990) is widely used: 10W + 6.25H − 5A + 5 (men, kcal/day, W kg, H cm, A years).
